classifications.rationale: This is a recital describing a statutory prerequisite imposed by Congress; it does not itself direct an agency or alter legal rights.
classifications.evidence: shall take effect only if approved by the Congress by the adoption of a concurrent resolution of approval

classifications.rationale: The President conditionally gives the proclamation and trade agreement legal effect and extends nondiscriminatory treatment once the specified congressional approval and exchange of notices occur; no later agency determination is required.
classifications.evidence: nondiscriminatory treatment shall be extended to the products of the Socialist Republic of Romania
